Body.Content:
Store Commerce inventory screens are being modernized with a new, responsive experience built on Fluent UI and React. The modern inventory views give store associates a consistent look and feel and fewer clicks across everyday inventory tasks, and they extend the modern inventory lookup experience to all inventory operations in the store.

This feature includes:

Inbound inventory (receiving): A modern order list and grid with combined filters for ship and receive dates, source and destination store, and status, plus updated detail pages for receiving workflows.

Outbound inventory (picking): The same modern grid pattern for picking, with variant details kept in the order lines and quicker access to line-level product information.

Transfer orders: View source and destination, dates, and status history in a layout that matches the transfer order flow started from inventory lookup.

Stock counting: A modern stock count experience with a consistent command bar and responsive input.

Consistent detail pages: Shared detail pages for inbound and outbound operations with consistent navigation and actions.

Responsive design: Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, including bottom sheets on smaller screens.

Experiences that depend on Inventory Visibility are hidden when Inventory Visibility isn't set up.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
